question: How is the power described when it remains without emission?
premises: All things are what is to be illumined.
When devoid of emission, that same power is called the coiled power.
It is likewise called the coiled vital power.
inference: In its non-emissive state, the illuminating power abides as kundalini in both energetic and vital forms.
plain_english: When it is without emission, that same power, in relation to all things that are to be illumined, is called the coiled power and also the coiled vital power.
